BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS3 Residential Single-Unit

(Detached House) District symbols as shown on Map No. 2-M

in the area bounded by:



A line 260 feet south of and parallel to West Madison Street; South Waller Avenue; a

line 310 feet south of and parallel to West Madison Street; and thc alley next west of

and parallel to South Waller Avenue.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.
